facts: The market is held on Saturdays at Salamanca Place, beside Georgian sandstone warehouses, galleries, restaurants and cafes. Location: attraction description.

The listing describes local artisans, designers and producers selling Tasmanian-made products, food, timber craft, ceramics, wool and jewellery. It states that City of Hobart owns and operates the market. Location: attraction description.
